strata-qwen38.problem: Evaluate whether a smaller quantization can serve the large Qwen Flash Next family within Spark memory.
strata-qwen38.summary: Strata-DGX-Spark is a community ARM64 CUDA inference project for a specialized quantized workload.
integration: Review the fork, build an isolated ARM64 CUDA image and verify every model artifact.
Measure correctness, memory and API readiness before registering a workload profile.
notes: This remains an experimental integration, not a managed deployment recipe.

ncm-tinystories.problem: Research and compare an experimental model architecture on a bounded text-generation workload.
ncm-tinystories.summary: NCM is a research project with published code and evaluation checkpoints.
integration: Review the code/checkpoints and build a qualified CUDA runtime.
Use a reproducible TinyStories evaluation before considering a production service.
notes: A research workload does not provide an established business service by itself.

basalt.problem: Explore an alternative inference runtime after verifying platform compatibility.
basalt.summary: Basalt is an alternative inference project with platform-specific build requirements.
integration: Review the upstream build targets, dependencies and model support.
An ARM64/GB10 port and native qualification are required before registration.
notes: The upstream x86-64/SM120 build is not qualified for this Spark.
